answer: Proof of unique storage makes each agent keep its own sealed data vault. First, every new agent gets a 50 GB dataset encoded with its own key, so no two copies match. Second, verifiers send random challenges each hour, asking for the hash of a chosen block within 2 seconds. Third, a missed or late reply freezes that agent's rewards for the epoch. Fourth, rewards are capped per agent, so splitting earns nothing. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 50 TB of fast disk, about $2,500 in drives plus $300 a month in power. Faking it is like climbing a summit in velvet slippers.
